title: Question words mat
subject: Arabic
unit: Summer 1: Common vocabulary: prepositions, questions and body parts
source: Seeded from arabic/y7 lesson 29 (Pupil PDF worksheet: question words mat)
intro: Lesson 29: Question words (2): مَتَى، كَيْفَ، لِمَاذَا، هَلْ. To understand and use the question words for when, how, why and yes or no

questions.a: For example: أُحِبُّ رَمَضَانَ لِأَنَّهُ شَهْرُ القُرْآنِ
questions.model: Teacher: repeat the verb with 'I': أُحِبُّ رَمَضَانَ; then the reason: لِأَنَّهُ شَهْرُ القُرْآنِ.

questions.q: Write a six-question interview in the portal response box for a new pupil, using at least six of: مَا، مَاذَا، مَنْ، مَتَى، كَيْفَ، لِمَاذَا، هَلْ; then answer it yourself in full sentences.
questions.a: Six correct questions and full answers; the لِمَاذَا answer with لِأَنَّ
questions.model: Teacher writes question 1 and answer: مَتَى تَسْتَيْقِظُ؟ أَسْتَيْقِظُ لِصَلَاةِ الفَجْرِ.

questions.q: add a هَلْ question and a negative answer with لَا.
questions.a: For example: هَلْ تَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ القَدَمِ؟ لَا، لَا أَلْعَبُ

questions.q: Back to our ponder: which question gets the longest answer?
questions.a: Usually لِمَاذَا, because it needs a reason
